verdict.rationale: A keyless probe found the main guidance site, www.sos.state.mn.us, behind a Radware Bot Manager CAPTCHA interstitial, so the primary public reading surface is bot-walled. Only the mblsportal.sos.mn.gov portal pages were reachable and crawled, and they carry mostly navigation and account/filing help text rather than substantive guidance. missing for 10: CAPTCHA-free access to the main sos.state.mn.us guidance pages, evidence that substantive filing guidance is readable without a bot wall, a published robots.txt or agent-access policy.
